description: Create a release. If the tag does not yet exist, pass target_commitish so Forgejo creates the tag.

draft.description: Whether the release is a draft

prerelease.description: Whether the release is a prerelease

tag_name.description: Tag name for the release (created if it does not exist)

target_commitish.description: Branch or commit SHA the tag points at (only used when the tag does not yet exist)

name: create_release
